description: A Django route registered with keyword arguments is the same registration as one written positionally, and the detector read only node.args. Measured on doccano: 51 of its registrations name their arguments and 22 do not, and the engine enumerated 6 entry points of a 78-route application. This is the same mistake as reading an argument's position when it was written as a keyword, one level up, and it has now cost a surface twice. The findings here exist only because the keyword-written routes are enumerated, so a regression removes them rather than merely changing a count. The negative is a path() call with no view: nothing answers there, so it is not a registration.

expected.note: reached from the positional path and from the keyword-written re_path
a class-based view registered with route= and view=, expanded to its post method
